source.title: HsaDelta: An approximation to the greedy algorithm for differential compression
source.publication: IBM Journal of Research and Development 50(1), 149-166 (2006)
source.algorithm_attribution: Fixed-block HsaDelta: block fingerprints, suffix-array best-match lookup, byte extension, insert/copy commands.
source.implementation_status: bounded clean-room profile; source descriptions only

output.encoding: No count prefix. INSERT is (0, byte_count, byte_as_i64...); COPY is (1, reference_offset, byte_count).

contract.reference_blocks: Hash complete reference blocks at offsets 0, p, 2p, ...; ignore an incomplete reference tail.
contract.fingerprint: Fixed-width base-257 polynomial encoding of byte+1 digits; for p<=4 it is collision-free and fits signed i64.
contract.suffix_array: Build a lexicographic suffix array over the reference block-fingerprint sequence. Binary-search prefix intervals to find the maximum number d of matching consecutive block fingerprints.
contract.best_match_refinement: For each query offset, inspect suffixes with d or d-1 matching block fingerprints, then extend exact byte matches left and right.
contract.scan_rule: Search the next p version offsets as one window; choose longest extended match, then smaller target start, then smaller reference start. If no match exists, advance the scan by one byte.
contract.delta_rule: Emit pending version bytes as one INSERT before each selected COPY; append a final INSERT for remaining bytes.
contract.output_tie_rule: The first source with the smallest reference offset wins after the longest match and earliest target-start rules.
contract.variant_scope: Uses the fixed-block-size variant. The separate block-size-proportional-to-reference variant is excluded.
contract.bounded_refinement: The quick-index filter, pointer array, and packed block-hash table are omitted; ordinary suffix-array prefix bounds preserve the best-match method at this small bound.
contract.validation_order: Reject malformed/null input before output-buffer checks; errors leave output untouched.

workspace.meaning: Fixed arrays for at most 16 reference block hashes, suffix order, match candidates, and a 912-byte staged command stream.
